images.title: Abstract of Quarantine Regulations
images.caption: The paperwork of quarantine. British regulations, 1826.
images.alt: A broadside headed Abstract of Quarantine Regulations, with six closely printed columns of instructions for ships.
images.creator: British government
images.rights_note: Wellcome image record rtwc97vd identifies this digitisation as public domain.
images.context: Instructions for ships arriving in British waters. The cover introduces the maritime-quarantine dossier; it is a historical document, not current guidance.
images.changes: Resized and encoded as WebP; cover presentation crops through CSS. No colourisation or retouching. The full uncropped image is shown on the credits page.

images.title: Influenza ward, Walter Reed Hospital, Washington, D.C.
images.caption: A nurse takes a patient’s pulse. Walter Reed, c. 1918.
images.alt: A masked nurse takes a patient’s pulse beside a line of hospital beds on a long open-sided ward.
images.creator: Harris & Ewing
images.rights_note: The Library of Congress states “No known restrictions on publication.” The catalogue dates the photograph c. 1918, Nov. 1, and cautions that its older caption-card data is unverified.
images.context: A clinical scene from the 1918 influenza pandemic, one event within the much longer timeline.
images.changes: Resized and encoded as WebP; cover presentation crops through CSS. No colourisation or retouching. The full uncropped image is shown on the credits page.

images.title: Smallpox virus virions, transmission electron micrograph
images.caption: Smallpox virions under an electron microscope, 1975.
images.alt: Black-and-white transmission electron micrograph of smallpox virions, including a particle with its internal viral core visible.
images.creator: CDC / Dr. Fred Murphy; Sylvia Whitfield
images.rights_note: PHIL 1849 explicitly identifies this image as public domain, free of copyright restrictions.
images.context: The image depicts smallpox virus, one of the atlas’s pathogen profiles. The resized detail is not a calibrated measurement image.
images.changes: Resized and encoded as WebP; cover presentation crops through CSS. No colourisation or retouching. The full uncropped image is shown on the credits page.

images.title: The Dreadnought, hospital ship for seamen, at Greenwich
images.caption: A floating hospital. Dreadnought at Greenwich, 1870.
images.alt: An 1870 engraving of the large Dreadnought hospital ship moored off Greenwich, with small rowing boats alongside.
images.creator: The Illustrated London News; engraver not identified
images.rights_note: Wellcome image record hubucktr, image V0013350, marks this digitisation as public domain.
images.context: A documented hospital ship. The interactive cutaway inside the exhibit remains a separate schematic teaching model and does not reconstruct this vessel.
images.changes: Resized and encoded as WebP; cover presentation crops through CSS. No colourisation or retouching. The full uncropped image is shown on the credits page.

images.title: Plan of Boston & vicinity
images.caption: Boston and its entrenchments. Manuscript map, c. 1775.
images.alt: A hand-drawn map of Boston and surrounding waterways, with buildings and entrenchments marked on aged paper.
images.creator: Cartographer unidentified
images.rights_note: Eighteenth-century manuscript map. Library of Congress Geography and Map Division; the catalogue dates it [1775?] and the download is unrestricted.
images.context: Geographic context for movement and encampments. The map does not itself record disease cases. North is to the left in the original.

images.title: Examination of Viking jaw and teeth
images.caption: Examining the evidence. Teeth and jaw from Varnhem.

images.context: Photograph released with the 2023 Varnhem dental study cited in the exhibit. The Varnhem sample is distinct from the Ribe and Birka samples.
